sentence: This project builds mathematical models to study how self-powered living cells and materials change shape and move together.
This project explores how miniature robots that use very little power can sense and track inventory in warehouses.
This project plans a computer system that uses artificial intelligence to bring together water data from many sources.
This project studies the behavior, hormones and brain of coyotes to find out how pairs form and keep their bonds.
This project builds sensor systems and forecasting tools to detect viruses circulating in wildlife before they cause pandemics.
This project uses artificial intelligence to help security analysts sort software vulnerabilities in research computing systems and match them to fixes.
This project studies how solutions to equations describing elasticity, fluids and moving particles behave and when they stop being smooth.
This project replaces an old mass spectrometer with a modern one that measures the masses of individual molecules.
This project builds devices from atomically-thin layers of materials so that neural networks using light can make decisions quickly.
This project studies gases released by western wildfires and how they change the air, using laboratory experiments, field measurements and a computer model.
This project studies how animals repair and renew themselves after injury and as they age, using several animal models.
This project studies how more hurricanes and droughts change tropical forests, their plants and animals, and the carbon and nutrients in soil and streams.
This project designs and controls soft, flexible robotic arms that can help people with daily tasks such as opening doors and picking up items.
This project builds a way to protect cellular networks by securing the data itself rather than the sessions between devices.
This project studies how nanomaterials and catalysts are made and put together, and looks at them with nanoscale imaging.
This project builds data science modules into computer science courses, including ones on machine learning for computer security.
This project studies how bacteria in biofilms send signals to each other and act together like multicellular organisms.
